# TG Validator Telegram Bulk Username Profile Check
> Official examples for the TG Validator bulk product `tg_username_profile_batch`.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://tgvalidator.com/products/tg_username_profile_batch): User id, last-seen time, active days, member flag and avatar URL for a whole list of usernames.
- [API documentation](https://tgvalidator.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tgvalidator/telegram-bulk-username-profile-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://tgvalidator.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://tgvalidator.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: TG Validator.
- Product code: tg_username_profile_batch.
- Mode: asynchronous bulk task.
- API base URL: https://tgvalidator.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Submit: POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with product=tg_username_profile_batch and a file field.
- Poll: GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id}; status is processing, success or failed.
- Poll interval: no more than once every 30 seconds.
- Task size: 1000 to 100000 entries, .txt or .csv, one Telegram username per line (the leading `@` is optional).
- Input kind: username.
- Country: not applicable, the field is not sent.
- Result columns: username, activated, uid, lastseen, activedays, member, avatar_url.
- Billing: the file is reserved on submit; only checked entries are charged and the rest is returned. Failed tasks are refunded.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
